sentences.en: Is Algeria really following a policy of import substitution?
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚真的在实行进口替代政策吗？

sentences.en: In professional soccer matches, there are only three substitutions allowed per game.
sentences.zh: 在职业足球比赛中，每场比赛只允许替换三次。

sentences.en: At half time, both teams made substitutions.
sentences.zh: 半场休息时，两队都进行了人员调整。

senses.zh: 代替；代用；替换取代(作用)；代换，代入代替物；代用品；替换物
